name: Binaural Quest
description: Video game music for headphones: original pieces in classic game styles that use the space between your ears as part of the level. A title screen whose arpeggios hop from ear to ear, an overworld split by partials, a dungeon with drips and torches all around you and a beast circling in the dark, a stealth mission behind walls, a boss whose theme rolls inside your head, a secret room with a jingle hidden in noise, a racing circuit where rivals lap around you, a space shooter with lasers crossing your head, a puzzle room of clocks in every corner and a save point humming on a slow delta drone. The kick, bass and lead stay in the centre; each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Title Screen
sketches.description: Press start: a chiptune hero theme in the centre while the arpeggio leans right with a level difference and a patterned ear swap flips some notes to the left. The noise-channel hats circle your head every two bars.
sketches.source:
setcpm(150/4)

// The hero theme on a pulse wave, dead centre
lead: note("<[c5 ~ g4 c5 e5 ~ g5 e5] [f5 ~ e5 d5 c5 ~ d5 e5] [a5 g5 e5 c5 d5 ~ g4 ~] [c5@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("square").pw(.25).vib(6).vibdepth(.05)
  .attack(.001).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05).gain(.18)

// ild makes the right ear louder; earswap flips the steps marked 1 to the left: C, F, Am, G
arp: note("<[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 [f4 a4 c5 f5]*2 [a3 c4 e4 a4]*2 [g3 b3 d4 g4]*2>")
  .s("square").pw(.5).ild(8).earswap("0 1 0 1 1 0 1 0")
  .decay(.05).sustain(0).gain(.1)

// A triangle bass jumping octaves, centred
bass: note("<[c2 c3]*4 [f1 f2]*4 [a1 a2]*4 [g1 g2]*4>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.1).sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.45)

// Noise-channel drums: kick and snare centred, hats circling your head every two bars
kick: note("c2 ~ [~ c2] ~").s("sine").penv(30).pdecay(.04).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.55)
snare: s("~ white ~ white").hpf(2000).decay(.1).sustain(0).gain(.22)
hats: s("white*8").hpf(9000).decay(.02).sustain(0)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).distance(1.5).posglide(.2).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Overworld
sketches.description: Setting out across the map: a flute plays the adventure theme in the centre, the march chords send alternate partials to each ear and the drums split their lows from their highs. A stream runs on your left and birds sing ahead.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)

// The world map: wind in the grass, a stream on your left, birds ahead and to the right
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.08)
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-70).distance(4).gain(.14)
birds: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(40).elevation(20).distance(5).gain(.18)

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials between the ears: G, C, Em, D
chords: note("<[g3,b3,d4] [c4,e4,g4] [e3,g3,b3] [d3,f#3,a3]>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~")
  .s("square").pw(.3).earsplit("harmonics").lpf(2400).decay(.15).sustain(.2).gain(.12)

// The adventure theme on a flute, straight ahead
flute: note("<[g4@2 a4 b4 d5@3 b4] [c5@2 b4 a4 g4@4] [e4 g4 a4 b4 a4@2 g4 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.6).release(.3).room(.4).gain(.24)

// A bouncing, centred bass
bass: note("<[g2 d2]*2 [c2 g2]*2 [e2 b1]*2 [d2 a1]*2>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.4)

// earsplit("bands") puts the drums' lows in one ear and their highs in the other
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8").earsplit("bands").splitfreq(900).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Dungeon Crawl
sketches.description: Headphones on: water drips all around you in a stone hall, a torch burns on each wall, your footsteps follow close behind and something large breathes as it circles you in the dark. A drone's phase turns slowly between the ears, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning.

sketches.name: Stealth Mission
sketches.description: Crouched in the vents: a wide hush of decorrelated noise, a sonar ping from a new direction each bar and guards pacing beyond the walls. Nothing is panned, yet the bass's brightness creeps from ear to ear, and the pad is thinner on the right.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// The vents: unrelated noise in each ear, a wide hush all around
air: s("pink").slow(8).icorr(.1).hpf(300).lpf(2500).gain(.04)

// A sonar ping from a new direction each bar: ahead, right, behind, left
sonar: note("e5 ~ ~ ~").s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(2).decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(2)
  .azimuth("<0 90 180 -90>").distance(4).room(.5).gain(.1)

// Guards pacing beyond the walls, left and right
guard1: s("step ~ step ~").azimuth(-100).distance(4).occlude(.6).gain(.14)
guard2: s("~ step ~ step").azimuth(110).distance(6).occlude(.6).gain(.1)

// A low-pass on each ear alone, sweeping in opposite directions every four bars
bass: note("e1 ~ e1 ~ g1 ~ e1 [~ f1]").s("sawtooth").lpq(5)
  .lcutoff(saw.range(200, 1600).slow(4)).rcutoff(isaw.range(200, 1600).slow(4))
  .decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.38)

// A muted, centred kit, and a tense pad with a high-pass on the right ear only
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~").lpf(3000).gain(.32)
pad: note("<[e3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,a3]>").slow(2).s("triangle").rhcutoff(1200)
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(2).room(.5).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Boss Battle
sketches.description: The final guardian: a centred kick and bass hold the arena while the boss theme's interaural phase turns once or twice a second, so it rolls inside your head. Orchestra stabs widen bar by bar on growing delays, and an alarm swings from ear to ear every fourth bar.
sketches.source:
setcpm(156/4)

// The floor of the arena: centred drums and bass
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.3).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").room(.3).gain(.55),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain("[.25 .1]*8")
)
bass: note("e1 e1 f1 e1 g1 e1 f1 d1").s("sawtooth").lpf(900).lpq(4)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.45)

// irate turns the lead's phase between the ears, one or two turns a second, below 3 Hz
lead: n("<[0 1 4 3 4@2 7 6] [7 6 4 3 1@2 0 1] [4 5 7 8 7@2 5 4] [3 1 0 -1 0@4]>").scale("E:phrygian").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).irate("<1 2>")
  .lpf(3000).attack(.01).sustain(.6).release(.1).gain(.18)

// From about 1 to 30 ms the stabs stay on the leading side but grow wider each bar
stabs: note("[e3,g3,b3,e4]").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .itd("<1 8 15 25>").lpf(3500).decay(.25).sustain(0).room(.4).gain(.2)

// Under about 0.7 ms the delay moves a sound sideways: the alarm swings every fourth bar
alarm: note("<~ ~ ~ [b4 e5 b4 e5]>").s("square").pw(.3)
  .itd(sine.range(-.6, .6).fast(2)).decay(.2).sustain(.4).gain(.1)

sketches.name: Secret Area
sketches.description: You found a hidden room. Each ear alone hears only a hiss of white noise; together they carry the discovery jingle (Huggins pitch). A quiet pulse plays it once every four bars so you know what to listen for, while treasure sparkles around you. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Racing Circuit
sketches.description: Synthwave at full throttle: a rival car laps around your head every two bars while the kick, bass and race theme stay straight ahead. The pad's ears drift apart in cents, a bar at a time, from a slow beat to a wide chorus.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)

// A rival car laps around your head every two bars, gliding between positions
rival: s("engine*4").lpf(1200).azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2))
  .distance(3).posglide(.3).gain(.12)

// Synthwave drums and a sixteenth-note bass, centred on the track
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.5).gain(.5),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7500).gain("[.25 .1]*8")
)
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").ply(16).s("sawtooth").lpf(1100).lpq(4)
  .decay(.09).sustain(.15).release(.03).gain(.45)

// earsh raises the right ear and lowers the left: 2 cents beats slowly, 30 blooms into a chorus
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .earsh("<2 6 12 30>").attack(.2).release(.8).lpf(1800).room(.5).gain(.14)

// The race theme, straight ahead
lead: note("<[e5@3 d5 c5@2 b4 a4] [c5@4 a4@4] [g5@3 f5 e5@2 d5 c5] [b4@4 d5@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).mono(1).glide(.04).vib(5).vibdepth(.1).lpf(3000)
  .attack(.01).sustain(.6).release(.15).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Space Shooter
sketches.description: An arcade shoot-'em-up: lasers fly across your head on delays under a millisecond, enemy formations swoop overhead from left to right and the starfield pad steps from the centre of your head to all around it. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the pad nearly vanish.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)

// Lasers: a falling pitch, and a delay under a millisecond that throws each shot to one side
lasers: note("c6*8?0.5").s("square").pw(.2).penv(-24).pdecay(.08).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .itd("[-0.6 0.6]*4").seed("lasers").gain(.08)

// The starfield: 0 degrees centred, 90 looser, 180 diffuse and nearly gone in mono
pad: note("<[c3,g3,d4] [ab2,eb3,c4] [bb2,f3,d4] [g2,d3,b3]>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .iphase("<0 90 180 90>").lpf(1400).attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.12)

// Enemy formations swoop overhead, crossing from left to right each bar
enemies: note("[g4 f4 eb4 d4]*2").s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90)).elevation(40).distance(3).posglide(.1).gain(.1)

// A centred kit and bass
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.75),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(.4),
  s("[~ hh]*4").hpf(7000).gain(.25)
)
bass: note("<c2 ab1 bb1 g1>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~").s("square").pw(.3).lpf(800)
  .decay(.1).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.4)

// The pilot's theme, straight ahead
lead: n("<[0 2 4 7] [5 4 2 ~] [4 5 7 9] [7@4]>").scale("C:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.25).vib(6).vibdepth(.05).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).gain(.16)

sketches.name: Puzzle Room
sketches.description: Thinking music: three clocks tick in five, six and seven from three corners of the room, a rotating marimba figure drifts apart in cents between the ears, and a chime rings when a piece clicks into place, swapping ears each bar.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// Three clocks in three corners: five, six and seven ticks sharing one step size
clock1: s("{tick tick tick tick tick}%8").azimuth(-60).distance(2).gain(.12)
clock2: s("{rim ~ rim ~ rim ~}%8").azimuth(60).distance(2).gain(.1)
clock3: s("{click ~ ~ click ~ click ~}%8").hpf(2000).azimuth(180).distance(3).gain(.1)

// The marimba figure rotates each bar, and its ears drift apart in cents
marimba: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 5 4").scale("F:major").iter(4)
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).earsh("<2 6 12 6>").decay(.35).sustain(0).room(.3).gain(.22)

// A chime when a piece fits: the right ear louder, swapped every other bar
chime: note("<[~ ~ ~ c6] [~ ~ ~ a5]>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(2.76).ild(6).earswap("<0 1>")
  .decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(1.5).room(.5).gain(.12)

// Soft chords and a centred bass: Fmaj7, Dm7, Bbmaj7, C7
pad: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,bb3]>").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).lpf(1500).room(.5).gain(.14)
bass: note("<f2 d2 bb1 c2>").s("sine").attack(.05).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.3).gain(.35)

sketches.name: Save Point
sketches.description: Headphones on: a safe room with a glowing crystal. A 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, a music box plays the save theme above your head in 3/4, a campfire crackles to one side and a healing shimmer circles you slowly.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/3)

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4
// A 2 Hz binaural drone: each ear is detuned by 1 Hz, below the 3-30 Hz warning range
drone: note("[c2,g2]").slow(8).s("sine").binaural(2)
  .attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.24)

// The save theme on a music box, floating above your head: C, G, F, C, C, G, C, C
musicbox: note("<[e5 g5 c6] [b5@2 g5] [a5 f5 a5] [g5@3] [e5 g5 c6] [d6@2 b5] [c6 g5 e5] [c6@3]>")
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).attack(.002).decay(1).sustain(0).release(1.5)
  .elevation(40).distance(2).room(.6).size(.85).gain(.2)

// A soft root on each downbeat
bass: note("<c2 g1 f1 c2 c2 g1 c2 c2>").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(1).sustain(0).release(1).gain(.2)

// A healing shimmer circling you slowly, and a campfire to one side
shimmer: n(irand(6).segment(3)).scale("C:major pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.5).seed("save")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.8).sustain(0).release(1)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(8)).distance(2).posglide(.4).gain(.07)
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.2).density(4).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.12)
